Chicago has several nationally renowned personal injury law firms and trial lawyers with records of multi-million dollar recoveries. When looking for the best attorney for your situation, it helps to look at firms known for specific strengths—whether that is catastrophic injury, medical malpractice, motor vehicle accidents, or aggressive negotiation against insurance companies.

Some of the top-rated and most established personal injury law firms in Chicago include:

1. Clifford Law Offices

Best For: Catastrophic injuries, wrongful death, aviation disasters, and massive commercial litigation.

Overview: Founded by Robert A. Clifford (frequently rated among the top lawyers in Illinois), this is one of the largest and most prominent plaintiff's personal injury firms in the country. They have recovered over $5 billion in verdicts and settlements and have handled major cases involving commercial aviation crashes, medical malpractice, and product liability.

2. Levin & Perconti

Best For: Nursing home abuse, elder neglect, medical malpractice, and severe workplace accidents.

Overview: This firm has built a stellar national reputation specifically for holding nursing homes, hospitals, and medical professionals accountable. They have secured numerous record-breaking verdicts and settlements in Illinois for victims of institutional negligence.

3. Cooney & Conway

Best For: Asbestos, mesothelioma, and toxic tort litigation.

Overview: Operating for over 50 years, Cooney & Conway is a powerhouse in handling complex asbestos and mesothelioma claims. They have recovered billions of dollars for injured workers and families affected by occupational exposure.

4. Horwitz, Horwitz & Associates

Best For: Workers' compensation, construction accidents, and catastrophic personal injury.

Overview: A generational, highly respected trial firm in Chicago known for fighting aggressively for injured workers and accident victims. They have secured some of the highest construction accident and workers' comp verdicts in Illinois history.

5. Malman Law

Best For: High-volume personal injury, nursing home negligence, and slip-and-fall accidents.

Overview: Led by Steven Malman, the firm has helped tens of thousands of clients in the Chicago area over 30+ years. They are known for handling a broad spectrum of injury claims efficiently and securing quick, substantial settlements.

6. The Kryder Law Group, LLC

Best For: Motor vehicle accidents, truck accidents, and personal injury.

Overview: Highly rated by local clients and peers alike, this firm handles car, truck, motorcycle, and CTA transit accidents, known for being responsive and keeping insurance adjusters from pushing lowball offers.

Tips for Choosing the Right Lawyer:

Contingency Fee Structure: Almost all reputable personal injury lawyers operate on a contingency fee basis (meaning you pay nothing upfront, and they only take a percentage if they win or settle your case).

Trial Experience: Many lawyers settle out of court, but you want a firm with a proven courtroom track record. Insurance companies offer higher settlements when they know a law firm is fully prepared and capable of taking them to trial.

Free Consultation: Take advantage of free initial case evaluations to speak directly with an attorney about the specifics of your accident, liability, and potential recovery timeline.
